note: This template ships with NO embedded font binaries so the package stays free of font-license restrictions and safe to redistribute. All fonts below are open-licensed and safe to self-host if you want the exact intended look; every text style also carries a system-font fallback so the label renders correctly even if none of these are installed.
howToEmbedForPrint: For press/rasterized output, install the desired font family locally (or embed it in Illustrator via Type > Add Fonts from your OS/Adobe Fonts) before opening master-label.svg — sharp/pdfkit in scripts/build.js render text as system fonts are available at build time, so install fonts on the build machine as well if you need exact typography in automated PNG/PDF output.
